messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['Automatically Upgrade Your Account.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Click here to discontinue using our service.', 'To ensure that your service is not interrupted, please update your billing information today by clicking here https://www.aol.com/', 'This is an official notification from HSBC Bank plc that the service listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not renewed immediately.', 'This is your official notification that the service(s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not verified immediately.', "We're closing some of our older email services.", 'As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service(s) listed below: SERVICE: Chase Online and Bill Pay services.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Manage your account by upgrading, renewing, or canceling services, and update billing or verify details promptly to prevent interruption or deactivation."}
